command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(id -un)" = ai-core-node; case "$(hostname)" in ai-core-node*) ;; *) echo WRONG_HOST:$(hostname) >&2; exit 71;; esac; REPO=/home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo; SHA=3064fb21566b9455732fbe143d56911ade45b24e; test "$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse origin/main)" = "$SHA"; SNAP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega777-3064fb2.XXXXXX); git -C "$REPO" archive "$SHA" | tar -x -C "$SNAP"; echo SNAPSHOT:$SNAP; echo '=== PRE SERVICES ==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service --no-pager -p Id -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID 2>&1 || true; bash "$SNAP/scripts/install_voice_777_omega.sh"; echo '=== INSTALLED HASHES ==='; for f in omega_organ_activity.py voice_777_runtime.py voice_host_777_live_client.py frank_terminal_777.py; do printf '%s source=' "$f"; sha256sum "$SNAP/scripts/$f" | awk '{print $1}'; printf '%s live=' "$f"; sha256sum "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/$f" | awk '{print $1}'; done; echo '=== DROPINS ==='; systemctl --user cat frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service 2>&1 | tail -80 || true; systemctl --user cat frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service 2>&1 | tail -80 || true; echo '=== POST SERVICES NO RESTART ==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service --no-pager -p Id -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID 2>&1 || true; echo '=== TERMINAL ==='; test -x "$HOME/.local/bin/frank-omega"; head -5 "$HOME/.local/bin/frank-omega"
